en.title: Israeli strike kills three in Gaza aid vehicle; Eisenkot faces coalition vote deadline
en.dek: An Israeli strike killed three people in a Gaza aid vehicle as Gadi Eisenkot works to form a government before the December 6 deadline.
facts: Israeli strike killed three people in a vehicle distributing food aid in Gaza on November 21, 2026
IDF stated it targeted terrorists masquerading as aid workers
Police arrested a Tel Aviv resident for threatening Naftali Bennett
Gadi Eisenkot is planning a vote on a minority government before December 6
body: Police arrested a Tel Aviv resident for allegedly posting threats to shoot Naftali Bennett and his son, according to The Jerusalem Post and The Times of Israel. The suspect reportedly shared a 2022 letter and claimed he traveled from the future to save the government.

An Israeli strike killed three people in a vehicle distributing food aid in Gaza on November 21, 2026, according to witnesses and the Gaza Health Ministry. The Israel Defense Forces stated it targeted terrorists masquerading as aid workers in the vehicle.

Witnesses and multiple outlets including Al Jazeera and Reuters reported the vehicle was distributing aid at the time of the strike. The incident occurred during ongoing military operations in the region.

Gadi Eisenkot is planning a vote on a minority government before the December 6 deadline, according to reports. Naftali Bennett has publicly backed Eisenkot for prime minister while calling for a unity government.
The Organiser report noted Haredi and Arab deadlock is looming as the December 6 deadline approaches. Political leaders continue to negotiate the formation of a new coalition government.
en.context: Israeli military operations in Gaza and coalition formation talks within the Israeli government have continued amid ongoing conflict. The strike occurred during active hostilities, while coalition talks involve potential leadership changes and government stability.

de.dek: Drei Hilfskräfte in Gaza-Schlag getötet, Koalitionsgespräche nähern sich Frist
body: Ein israelischer Schlag tötete drei Personen in einem Fahrzeug, das Lebensmittelhilfe in Gaza verteilte, am 21. November 2026, so Zeugen und das Gesundheitsministerium von Gaza.
Die israelischen Verteidigungsstreitkräfte gaben an, Terroristen ins Visier genommen zu haben, die sich als Hilfskräfte im Fahrzeug tarnten.
Zeugen und mehrere Medien, darunter Al Jazeera und Reuters, berichteten, dass das Fahrzeug zum Zeitpunkt des Schlages Hilfe verteilte.
Gadi Eisenkot plant eine Abstimmung über eine Minderheitsregierung vor der Frist am 6. Dezember, so Berichten zufolge.
Naftali Bennett unterstützt Eisenkot öffentlich als Premierminister und fordert gleichzeitig eine Einheitsregierung.
Der Organiser-Bericht wies darauf hin, dass ein Patt zwischen Haredim und Arabern näher rückt, während die Frist am 6. Dezember naht.

en.headline: Tel Aviv man arrested for threats against Naftali Bennett
en.body: Police arrested a Tel Aviv resident for allegedly posting threats to shoot Naftali Bennett and his son. According to The Jerusalem Post and The Times of Israel, the suspect shared a 2022 letter and added a caption claiming he came from the future to save the government.

es.headline: Detenido un hombre en Tel Aviv por amenazar a Naftali Bennett
es.body: La policía ha detenido a un residente de Tel Aviv por presuntamente publicar amenazas de disparar contra Naftali Bennett y su hijo. Según The Jerusalem Post y The Times of Israel, el sospechoso compartió una carta de 2022 y añadió un pie de foto en el que afirmaba venir del futuro para salvar al Gobierno.

de.headline: Mann aus Tel Aviv wegen Drohungen gegen Naftali Bennett festgenommen
de.body: Die Polizei hat einen Einwohner von Tel Aviv festgenommen, der mutmaßlich damit gedroht hat, Naftali Bennett und dessen Sohn zu erschießen. Laut der Jerusalem Post und der Times of Israel teilte der Verdächtige einen Brief aus dem Jahr 2022 und fügte eine Bildunterschrift hinzu, in der er behauptete, aus der Zukunft zu kommen, um die Regierung zu retten.

it.headline: Arrestato un uomo a Tel Aviv per minacce contro Naftali Bennett
it.body: La polizia ha arrestato un residente di Tel Aviv per aver presumibilmente pubblicato minacce di sparare a Naftali Bennett e a suo figlio. Secondo il Jerusalem Post e il Times of Israel, il sospettato ha condiviso una lettera del 2022 aggiungendo una didascalia in cui sosteneva di provenire dal futuro per salvare il governo.

fr.headline: Un habitant de Tel-Aviv arrêté pour des menaces contre Naftali Bennett
fr.body: La police a arrêté un habitant de Tel-Aviv pour avoir prétendument publié des menaces de mort à l'encontre de Naftali Bennett et de son fils. Selon le Jerusalem Post et le Times of Israel, le suspect a partagé une lettre datant de 2022 en y ajoutant une légende affirmant qu'il venait du futur pour sauver le gouvernement.

pt.headline: Homem de Telavive detido por ameaças contra Naftali Bennett
pt.body: A polícia deteve um residente de Telavive por alegadamente publicar ameaças de disparar contra Naftali Bennett e o seu filho. Segundo o The Jerusalem Post e o The Times of Israel, o suspeito partilhou uma carta de 2022 e acrescentou uma legenda afirmando que vinha do futuro para salvar o governo.

zh.headline: 特拉维夫一名男子因威胁纳夫塔利·贝内特被捕
zh.body: 警方逮捕了一名特拉维夫居民，该男子涉嫌发布威胁，声称要枪杀纳夫塔利·贝内特及其儿子。据《耶路撒冷邮报》和《以色列时报》报道，嫌疑人分享了一封2022年的信件，并配文称自己来自未来，旨在拯救政府。

ko.headline: 텔아비브 남성, 나프탈리 베네트 전 총리 협박 혐의로 체포
ko.body: 경찰이 나프탈리 베네트 전 총리와 그의 아들을 총살하겠다는 협박 글을 게시한 혐의로 텔아비브 거주 남성을 체포했다. 예루살렘 포스트와 타임스 오브 이스라엘에 따르면, 용의자는 2022년에 작성된 편지를 공유하며 자신이 정부를 구하기 위해 미래에서 왔다는 내용의 글을 덧붙인 것으로 알려졌다.

ja.headline: テルアビブの男、ナフタリ・ベネット氏への脅迫容疑で逮捕
ja.body: 警察は、ナフタリ・ベネット氏とその息子を銃撃すると脅迫する投稿をした疑いで、テルアビブ在住の男を逮捕した。エルサレム・ポスト紙およびタイムズ・オブ・イスラエル紙によると、容疑者は2022年の書簡を共有した上で、「政府を救うために未来から来た」とする趣旨のキャプションを添えていたという。
